peptide.name: EchAMP
peptide.source_identity_note: Local XML/PDF report the EchAMP accession and 90 aa/71 aa lengths but do not print the exact 71 aa database sequence; database sequence is retained as database-snapshot identity with source-conflict caution, not promoted to exact primary-source verification.
peptide.modification_note: Primary local material reports a signal peptide/mature-length distinction and predicted O-glycosylation sites; no N-terminal amidation, D-amino acid, cyclization, disulfide, or lipidation is reported in local primary text.

activity_records.endpoint_description: qualitative/statistical bacteriostatic growth-curve outcome from Figure 10; not a MIC/MBC endpoint
activity_records.raw_value: significant inhibition of alamarBlue fluorescence growth curve versus pcDNA3 empty-vector control; P<0.05
activity_records.raw_unit: qualitative statistical RFU time-course result; no MIC/MBC concentration unit reported

assay_conditions.method: alamarBlue bacterial cell viability/growth assay in 96-well plate
assay_conditions.source_assay_volume: 100 bacterial cells in 50 uL ISA broth plus 40 uL EchAMP-conditioned medium or pcDNA3-conditioned medium and 10 uL alamarBlue
assay_conditions.controls: pcDNA3 empty-vector conditioned medium negative control; bacitracin 100 ug/mL positive control
assay_conditions.readout: fluorescence at excitation 544 nm and emission 590 nm measured hourly
assay_conditions.replicates_statistics: treatments in triplicate; experiments repeated at least three times; two-tailed t-test versus pcDNA3 empty vector with P<0.05 treated as significant
